title.narrative:
1) Food Land and Water Systems - accelerated just, inclusive, resilient and nature positive food systems transition in selected ODA-eligible countries (primarily in Sub-Saharan Africa)
Improve management and governance of food systems in max 5 selected ODA-eligible countries (primarily in Sub-Saharan Africa) to sustainably produce more food and fiber from existing production areas; reduce food loss and restore degraded areas to healthy and natural or productive ecosystems.
Approach or system for monitoring and mapping agricultural yield (for selected crops) and yield gaps developed.

target.value: No solutions identified. No tools developed.

actual.value: An early draft identification of solutions aimed at meeting the diverse needs of stakeholders was completed. Solutions identified include; off-grid solar-powered cold storage facilities and improved dry storage methods. One challenge is to secure financing for these technologies given their up-front cost.

Three key tools developed. Pilot phase launched in select regions: in Kenya the crop-type maps and crop mask developed for five counties in GRV. Crop mapping activities in LKR region in Rwanda deferred to FY25. Crop yield measurement protocol designed to assist Kenyas Ministry of Agriculture.

target.value: Establish online systems and tools supporting collection and analysis of baseline data on crop yields in Rwanda and Kenya.

title.narrative:
1) Food Land and Water Systems - accelerated just, inclusive, resilient and nature positive food systems transition in selected ODA-eligible countries (primarily in Sub-Saharan Africa)
Improve management and governance of food systems in max 5 selected ODA-eligible countries (primarily in Sub-Saharan Africa) to sustainably produce more food and fiber from existing production areas; reduce food loss and restore degraded areas to healthy and natural or productive ecosystems.
1.1. # of new policies and incentives promoting sustainable yield increases in Africa (e.g., Kenya, Rwanda, DRC, Ethiopia)

actual.value: An early draft identification of solutions aimed at meeting the diverse needs of stakeholders was completed. Solutions identified include; off-grid solar-powered cold storage facilities and improved dry storage methods. One challenge is to secure financing for these technologies given their up-front cost.

target.value: FY24 workplan includes establishing and updating a list of 5+ candidate "deals" on food loss reduction and drafting tools/methods derived from Food Loss & Waste Protocol, tailored to countries' contexts.

actual.value: Three key tools developed: the Land Degradation Assessment Index (for GRV and LKR), Crop Type Maps and mask (a detailed map outlining cultivated areas) and a Crop Productivity Monitoring Dashboard. Crop mapping activities especially carried out in Kenya and Rwanda.

title.narrative:
4) Operational adjustments and strengthening to deliver the Strategy - WRI strengthens its capacity to deliver on strategy.
WRI strengthened capacities in i) Planning, Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (PMEL), ii) integrating PGSE in its programs and projets and iii) to support growth and its positioning on the African continent.
4.2.1 The Equity Center develops a Rapid Social Analysis Tool and supports teams (IOs and Programs) to conduct rapid social analyses as part of the theory of change process of WRI's new strategy.

target.value: Equity Center develops RSA tool, while also training and mentoring RSA Leads.

actual.value:
Execution of RSAs for 22 ToC teams.
RSas were instrumental in strengthening in-country ToCs. Emphasis was on fostering inclusion and targeting historically marginalized groups.
RSAs refined Human Systems Transitions strategies by enhancing integration of gender equality, social equity and poverty reduction objectives.

target.value: the Equity Center develops a RSA Tool and supports teams (IOs and Programs) to conduct rapid social analyses as part of the theory of change process of WRI's new strategy.

actual.value: Rapid Social Analysis was successfully completed. Also developed a GSE mainstreaming resource guide and a WRI GSE Glossary. Launch of pilot training series for WRI staff.

target.value: Complete remaining Rapid Social Analyses as part of the Theory of Change Process initiated in FY24. Will provide technical support, training, and mentoring to teams working with political economy analysis.

title.narrative:
3) National Climate Action: NCA/NCE in Ethiopia, Kenya, Nigeria, South Africa, Vietnam, Brazil, Colombia
Integrated national and sectoral development planning and financing for just, inclusive, resilient, low-carbon, and nature positive climate actions is implemented in Ethiopia, Kenya, Nigeria, South Africa, Vietnam, Brazil, Colombia.
3.1.1 Key stakeholders consider integrating NCA analysis and recommendations when designing and implementing their strategies for a greener economic transition.

target.value: Inception phase, focus on solid foundation for research ahead.

actual.value: Initial discussions with in-country partners centered on determining optimal recipients & dissemination methods. WRI teams anticipate to present research results and recommendations to identified key stakeholders for further strategic alignment.

target.value: Research, analysis and development activities will carry over into FY24.

actual.value: Sustaining and expanding training programs designed to equip stakeholders with the necessary skills for implementing green economic strategies. Activities of supporting the design and implementation of green economic transition pathways. Examples include: contributing to the design of "energy communities" in Colombia, assistance with the completion and publication of first-ever ministerial status report in Kenya.

target.value: Build on research carried out in 2024 to create guidelines for key stakeholders with lessons learned and recommendations on how to adopt actionable policies. Activities will focus on presenting initial results to stakeholders.

title.narrative:
3) National Climate Action: NCA/NCE in Ethiopia, Kenya, Nigeria, South Africa, Vietnam, Brazil, Colombia
Integrated national and sectoral development planning and financing for just, inclusive, resilient, low-carbon, and nature positive climate actions is implemented in Ethiopia, Kenya, Nigeria, South Africa, Vietnam, Brazil, Colombia.

3.1. # of countries where integrated and actionable national and sectoral development planning & financing for just, inclusive, resilient, low carbon and nature positive systems climate actions are implemented.

target.value: Consolidating and presenting research results to key stakeholders and continue research development

actual.value: Design and implementation of green economic transition pathways were developed for Colombia, Kenya, and South Africa.

target.value: Establish solid foundation for research endeavors ahead

actual.value: Multiple coordination meetings conducted with local stakeholders. Capacity-building activities and knowledge sharing initiatives carried out. Successful identification of knowledge products and research results for further evaluation in preparation for wider dissemination.

target.value: 7 countries (Kenya, Nigeria, Colombia, Vietnam, Ethiopia, Brazil and South Africa)

title.narrative: 2) Human system transition - Cities Accelerated just, inclusive, resilient and nature positive Cities in transition in selected ODA-eligible countries (primarily in sub-Sarahan Africa), for accelerating cities adaptation and NbS, including the most vulnerable communities.
2.3: Local implementation. Number of nature-based solutions identified, designed, and/or implemented with the active participation of vulnerable communities.

actual.value: Selection of 10 cities within the identified geographies. City-specific activities defined for implementation in FY24. Developed cities-specific MEL framework, tailored to the needs of each city.
WRI supported the implementation of 5 on-the-ground PGSE responsive, and economic empowerment NBS projects in Dire Dawa, Kigali, Johannesburg, Bukavu, and Brazzaville.

title.narrative: 2) Human system transition - Cities Accelerated just, inclusive, resilient and nature positive Cities in transition in selected ODA-eligible countries (primarily in sub-Sarahan Africa), for accelerating cities adaptation and NbS, including the most vulnerable communities.
Identification, design, and/or implementation of community-led or supported nature-based solutions with vulnerable communities.

actual.value: Held 35 community-led engagements to identify catalytic NBS projects. Supported the implementation of 5 NBS projects. WRI also provided support to cities to develop strategies for incorporating vulnerable communities in the long-term monitoring and maintenance PGSE-responsive NBS projects.

target.value: Limited capacity among WRI partners (e.g. policy makers, practitioners, gov. officials, etc.) in NBS adaptation.

actual.value: WRI embarked on a number of initiatives aimed at fostering dialogue and collaboration among stakeholders; key events include World Water Week and COP28. During these gatherings WRI led discussions and delivered speeches on pressing topics on cities and adaptation of NBS

target.value: Continue the implementation of 3 on-the-ground NBS projects in selected African countries. cities will plant more than 75000 trees in total
